definitions.meaning: A foreign nation, foreign people, foreigners

quotations.old_english: Donne ða rícan beóþ oððe on ælþeóde oððe on hiora ágenre gecýððe
quotations.english: when the rich are among foreigners or in their own country

source_text: æl-Þeód, -þiód, e; f. A foreign nation, foreign people, foreigners :-- Donne ða rícan beóþ oððe on ælþeóde oððe on hiora ágenre gecýððe when the rich are among foreigners or in their own country, Bt. 27, 3 ; Fox 98, 34. v. el-þeód.
